# Waveshare ES8311 driver

es8311.c/.h and audio_pio.pio from Waveshare RP2350-Touch-LCD-1.54, commit 51a7fe28c1e5dd19a089a062980a275709e94df6, examples/C/02_ES8311. LICENSE retained; trailing whitespace normalised. DEV_Config.h and audio_pio.h are minimal NeuroCube compatibility shims; no factory application or microphone recording is included. Used only by infrastructure.
